result.summary: The page is generally clean; the horizontally clipped carousel items and the partially visible bottom card are expected scroll behavior and were excluded. The main visual defect is at the bottom navigation area, where the system gesture/navigation bar appears to overlap the middle tab icons.

issues.description: The Android gesture pill / system navigation bar is drawn across the center of the bottom tab bar, overlapping the search and cart icons so they look crowded, clipped, and misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom inset/padding to the app tab bar so it sits above the system gesture area, and space the tab icons evenly without the system bar crossing through them.
